# RandomlyTools

RandomlyTools is a free online tools website offering random generators, calculators, cricket tools, and other practical utilities.

## Main Website
- https://randomlytools.in/

## Cricket Tools
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-qualification-calculator/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-points-table-simulator/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-nrr-calculator/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-required-run-rate-calculator/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-chase-calculator/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-score-projection/
- https://randomlytools.in/cricket-playoff-calculator/

## Other Useful Tools
- https://randomlytools.in/random-name-generator/
- https://randomlytools.in/adsense-revenue-calculator/
- https://randomlytools.in/website-mockup-generator/

- https://randomlytools.in/about/

## Usage
Use the linked pages to discover and interact with the corresponding RandomlyTools calculators and generators. Tool outputs are generated from the inputs and rules described on each page.
